decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 10 October 2003, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed single-storey extension to the rear of the dwellinghouse having varying widths of 4.2m, 3.2m and 2.3m, and varying depths of 1.6m, 1.24m and 2.1m, respectively, with a flat roof height of 2.7m, qualifies as Class A, permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 

The proposed extension therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of single storey rear extension to provide bedroom & bathroom for disabled user to dwellinghouse.
